field_text_formatted.value: Anonymous GET was never affected, since a simple request is not preflighted. What changes is everything else: writes, and reads that set an Authorization header. If you keep a proxy rule or a middleware in front of your frontend so that authenticated calls succeed, this is the release where you delete it. Worth checking rather than assuming, because a refused preflight answers 204 with a clean log, and curl never reproduces it: only a browser enforces the response.
